entries.title: Kuressaare placement defect
entries.detail: cascade fired Over 1 @ 2.0 at 63'; the first tap opened the slip slowly, placement recovery misread it and re-tapped the same cell, toggling the slip closed; retry then refused. Bet 332 aborted, no money moved.

entries.title: Betting paused — fix queue non-empty (Danny's rule)
entries.detail: bot stopped and verified inactive; resumption gate = every queued fix built + landed.

entries.title: Tap-effect verdict fix
entries.detail: recovery taps can no longer toggle an already-open slip closed; a contradicted dead-marking can no longer refuse a retry.

entries.title: Javor arrival defect
entries.detail: row sighted repeatedly but no tap geometry derivable; the fixture's peer name in the slip post ("Sp. Subotica") starved every pair-keyed geometry leg.

entries.title: Javor row-geometry / name-resolution fix
entries.detail: the hunt adopts the sighted row's own rendered names; rendezvous march added for very long lists.

entries.title: Screen-channel blindness (Bristol pair + Javor wall)
entries.detail: phone-side screen-capture stalls in episodes while the link stays up; with OCR's on-device component broken, both senses fail together and 'wall not cleared' verdicts were minted blind. Fix building.

entries.title: System status record live
entries.detail: this feed is now the verified record of the fix lifecycle — every broken found → paused → fixing → fix landed → back on transition lands here and on Discord #status as it happens, with its evidence attached.

entries.title: Screen-channel blindness fix
entries.detail: Fix building: phone-side screen-capture stalls in episodes while the link stays up, and the second sense (OCR) is broken on the device, so both senses fail together. Fix = in-attempt channel recovery, a screenshot fallback sense, and honest cannot-read reporting instead of blind verdicts.

entries.title: Screen-channel blindness fix
entries.detail: Blind rounds can no longer mint a wall verdict: an unreadable screen now parks the attempt and waits out the episode instead of killing it; the park re-dials the session every 3rd failed probe; a screenshot + local-OCR fallback sense is wired for when the device OCR is dead. Bench 7/7 both arms, corpus zero flips. Five orphaned spinning processes that were starving the server CPU were also cleared at landing.

entries.title: Betting back on — fix queue empty
entries.detail: All three queued fixes are built and landed (tap-effect verdict, Javor row-geometry, screen-channel blindness). Bot restarted 15:30Z, health all-ok on fresh reads, bankroll 557.16, bets 332. First windows under watch: Harrogate 16:13Z, MTK Budapest 16:58Z.

entries.title: Arrival: cold navigation inside the window
entries.detail: Harrogate v Yeovil died at arrival across all three routes (search rendered the fixture as hits but yielded no tappable row; live list coverage incomplete; vision row rejected). Window starved 16:30Z, no bet. Class: navigating cold inside a 20-minute window.

entries.title: Bot stopped — build first (Danny's order)
entries.detail: Stopped 17:1xZ on Danny's word under the queue-empty rule. MTK Budapest camp was live with NO bet placed (Over 4.5/4.75/5 not offered); bet 334 placeholder only, no money moved. Slate paused until the arrival builds land.

entries.title: Park-early staging build
entries.detail: Builder dispatched: every slate game staged and parked on its fixture page before its window (MTK proved the pattern today — parked and verified 10 min early; Harrogate died hunting cold). A game that cannot be parked by T-30 gets declared early, not discovered dead at window open.

entries.title: Search-hit conversion build
entries.detail: Builder dispatched: when search renders the fixture as a hit but yields no tappable row (Harrogate 16:14Z), convert the hit into arrival instead of handing over empty — or prove the hits are decoys and hand over fast to the right route.

entries.title: Park-early staging
entries.detail: Every unparked game on the slip now carries a staging obligation from intake, and a game still unstaged at T-30 is declared loudly on the record instead of being discovered dead in-window. Bench 15/15, corpus zero flips, q83 identical. runner.py c6890100.

entries.title: Search-hit conversion
entries.detail: The Harrogate hits were a team suggestion plus a decoy card (Southend, Dec 5) - the live row never rendered. Search now converts a team hit into arrival via the team page; decoys are inventoried, never tapped. Bench 29/29, corpus zero flips, q83 identical. smart.py b92b5a02.

entries.title: Betting back on - arrival builds landed
entries.detail: Both arrival fixes landed and verified (runner c6890100, smart b92b5a02, py_compile clean). Bot restarted 17:44Z, bankroll 557.16, bets 334 intact. Remaining slate stages under the new park-early guarantee; first windows Holywell 18:28Z and Beitar 19:28Z. Live proofs owed and will post as PROOF EARNED or FAILED.

entries.title: Tap-effect verdict fix - live proof earned
entries.detail: First placement since the fix landed completed through the gate: bet 335 Slask Wroclaw, slip reached, stake set and read back, bet placed with receipt. The Kuressaare failure (re-tap toggling the open slip closed) did not recur.
